entries.739ac3323e171b29: The company has set the purpose 'TECHNOLOGY FOR THE EARTH – Technology to Protect the Earth' and is pursuing its business under the medium- to long-term vision 'POWER! FOR ALL beyond 2030', announced in November 2023. Its three priority issues are: strengthening the business foundation by improving safety, quality and productivity; responding to growth areas and improving its earnings structure by developing next-generation fuel-compatible engines and accelerating servitization, starting with comprehensive engine maintenance; and strengthening the management foundation through DX, human resources and governance. In May 2026 the company marks the 60th anniversary of its founding and the first anniversary of its name change.

entries.b6ded8bafbbe9379: Since separating from Daihatsu Motor in 1966, the company has consistently been engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of internal combustion engines. It has production sites at two plants in Moriyama and one in Himeji, and operates sales subsidiaries in the United States, Europe, China and Asia-Pacific, with a structure covering everything from engine sales to parts supply and maintenance. Another feature is that it is advancing servitization, starting with comprehensive engine maintenance.

entries.d07c9789e58b8e24: Marine engines are sold to shipbuilders in Japan and overseas, and land-use engines are sold to businesses introducing power generation facilities. Sales are centered on Japan and extend overseas to China, Asia, Latin America and other regions.
entries.d92b82ecbe609b54: This business manufactures and sells marine diesel engines and gas engines. It manufactures at the Moriyama Plant (Moriyama City, Shiga Prefecture) and the Himeji Plant (Himeji City, Hyogo Prefecture), and sells to shipbuilders and other customers through domestic and overseas sales subsidiaries, and also provides parts supply and maintenance services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥71,829 million, making it the largest business in the group.
